text: An expertly crafted series of logic puzzles, let down by the incessant ads on the free version, with the paid version removing the forced ones but not allowing me to remove the button. So far, I've been able to complete every level without power-ups (704 was a doozy!), though many of them took many attempts and planning. On that front, it's been a beautifully crafted logic puzzle! Sadly on the free version ads play after every level which are almost a puzzle in themselves to close. -*

I honestly have loved this game, so much so I paid to have no ads (with Google opinion money) but I've been trapped on level 1012 for days, I cannot figure out how to beat it (I think I've tried over 20 times but I just get locked out). I don't want to spend more/actual money so I just can't play it now 😭 wish there was an option to watch an ad for more power ups or something cause I don't have enough coins for anything 💔

actually enjoy this game sometimes till get to levels where not possibly to win without using abilities or paying to continue and then even when paying to continue sometimes the level resets so your paying for nothing cause the round ends and you lose your streak and then when emailing support you don't even get a response. worth a quick play but wouldn't wasted money anymore except for removing ads worth the £5

The game itself is a good game but not without it's flaws, like when you fail a level would be nice to have the feature of where you can watch an advert to revive yourself? I know all levels are beatable but that feature would be handy for new and existing users and gives chance for people to keep playing. Also they need to reduce the amount of ads like one after each level is a bit much so maybe do it after every 2 maybe 3 levels will be sufficient.

Fun concept, but a deeply flawed app. Long ads after every level attempt, successful or not, and levels that eventually become impossible without spending money or using limited powerups. Would love play the game further, but I am unwilling to spend money on a game of this quality and am therefore no longer able to.

I really really love this game, but I accidentally made a purchase of £40 because of face ID approvals being automatically turned on on my new phone - following this I contacted the developer to see if they could help but I have been ignored twice now. I'm really disappointed as I played this game constantly the last year or so, it was such a source of comfort but now it is such a cause of stress. The game itself is great, the developers not so much. I'll update my review if I ever hear back :(

Great game, recommended! Ads are very fair for a free-to-play mobile game with ads only being between the (good-sized) levels so no interruptions. Levels do not repeat up to at least 500 (where I'm up to). Some of the practises are scummy, one event promised a 7 level streak would award you 10,000 coins and then pays out just 1000.

Glitches and annoying stuff. No daily bonus or extra points for completing the harder levels, which is poor. Pixel shooter doesn't always fire, causing backup and you lose the level. No real "how to play" instructions, meaning you have to work certain levels out as you go along, not realising some of the colours capture a completely different colour. Too many long winded ads, that ALWAYS go to Google Play, then you've a 3 to 4 step process to get back into the game.

I was really enjoying this game and it was different, but then getting a forced advert after every level past 20 is just dumb. I will probably install it on my laptop and stick it in airplane mode so I can play without them. at least give us an option to buy no ads, that isn't about £10 as I wouldn't buy a game like this for less than £5.

would give it a minus but can't they let you get so far then they make it impossible to progress with out paying over and over, you can't earn coins enough even if you double up I'm up to level 284 and I'm not spending another penny, it's a shame because I enjoy the game but it's totally ruined it so it's getting deleted!

A shame as with some minor tweaks it could have been a very good game.

Scam app. They charge you to remove ads and I am totally fine paying to avoid ads - but then they force you to watch (loooooong) ads to get extra lives (unless you want to wait 30 mins between attempts!), and you have to pay for stuff that makes it possible to progress past level 125 as they rigged the difficulty to extract more money. Work out how much money you want to make per customer, and charge that up-front, or offer ads. Ad-free version shouldn't incorporate ads.
